nodes.title: GUIDE — Native 39f at Dynamic Seam Offset
Clip 1 Prompt
widgets_values:
summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 5-second, 16:9 high-energy Hollywood action-movie street fight centered on <Subject 1>. The supplied image is used only as a character, face, wardrobe, and equipment reference. The scene features a rain-slick urban street, two attackers, hard-hitting practical stunt choreography, aggressive camera pushes, controlled impact shake, dramatic backlight, and a fast commercial action-film rhythm. Keep the framing predominantly medium and medium-close so that <Subject 1>'s face, costume, physical performance, and combat technique remain clearly visible.

detailed_description:
The target video has a polished Hollywood action-movie style rather than a restrained spy-thriller style: punchy contrast, bold backlight, wet reflective pavement, practical stunt realism, sharp impact timing, controlled handheld energy, quick push-ins, snap pans, brief impact camera shake, and natural motion blur. Use predominantly medium and medium-close compositions, with <Subject 1> occupying 60–75% of the frame. Avoid wide establishing shots. Keep the action intense but non-graphic, with no visible blood, gore, broken bones, text overlays, logos, or watermarks.

[Shot 1] The video opens with a medium-full 50mm side-tracking shot, framed from the knees to the head. <Subject 1> strides through a rain-soaked city street as neon reflections and storefront lights streak across the blurred background. Two attackers step into her path. The camera performs a fast forward push-in as she stops, turns her shoulders, and adopts a confident fighting stance. A sharp musical hit and a burst of rain spray announce the action.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.800, cut to a medium close-up handheld shot framed from the chest to the thighs. The first attacker swings a collapsible baton. <Subject 1> ducks under it, traps the wrist, redirects the attacker into the sedan, and delivers a clean elbow strike. Add a brief controlled camera jolt exactly on impact, followed by a fast snap-pan as she pivots. Keep her face, gloved hands, harness, and upper-body mechanics readable.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, use a medium-full low-angle 40mm shot. The second attacker rushes from behind. <Subject 1> catches the arm, rolls across the wet hood of the sedan, and throws the attacker onto the pavement in a controlled stunt fall. Use a brief speed-ramp feeling during the reversal, then return to normal speed as water splashes across the lens. Her hair, jacket tails, heels, and athletic footwork remain physically coherent.


overall_soundscape:
Heavy rain, wet footsteps, jacket and harness movement, baton whooshes, sharp stunt impacts, car-door clangs, body sliding across metal, tire hiss, water splashes, distant traffic, and a rising police siren. Add controlled low-frequency impact hits synchronized with major strikes. No spoken dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
A high-energy Hollywood action score at approximately 132 BPM, with pounding cinematic drums, distorted synth bass, aggressive string ostinatos, metallic percussion, rising brass stabs, and short sub-bass impacts synchronized to the fight choreography. The music escalates rapidly through [Shot 2], peaks near the end of [Shot 3], and carries its momentum directly into the continuation.
